errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: The app hit an unexpected error. A reload usually fixes it. If not, resetting local data will clear caches and settings — your wallet stays safe (you'll just re-enter your password).

tutorial.s1b: An un-deplatformable photo network on RougeChain. Your account is a key you hold — no one can shadowban or disable it.
tutorial.s2b: Tap + to post photos and carousels, write text posts and X-style threads, drop a 24h story, or shoot a reel.
tutorial.s3b: Home has Following and Discover. Explore surfaces trending posts and people, and Reels is a full-screen vertical feed.
tutorial.s4b: Follow, like, comment, and tip XRGE. DMs are end-to-end encrypted (ML-KEM-768) — not even the network can read them.
tutorial.s5b: Your photos and identity live on-chain, signed by your key. Back up your recovery phrase in Settings — it's the only way in.

onboarding.pwMin8: Password must be at least 8 characters.
onboarding.keysRequired: Both public and private keys are required.
onboarding.heroTitle: Photos nobody can take away from you.
onboarding.heroBody: RouGee is a photo network on RougeChain — a post-quantum blockchain. Your account is a cryptographic key you hold, not a row in someone's database. No shadowbans. No disabled accounts. No gatekeeper.
onboarding.feat1: You own your identity — a key, not an email/phone.
onboarding.feat2: Posts, likes & follows live on-chain, signed by you.
onboarding.feat3: Photos are content-addressed & portable — no silent takedowns.
onboarding.welcomeBody: Create an account in seconds. No sign-up form, no verification — just a key that's yours.
onboarding.havePhrase: I already have a recovery phrase
onboarding.clearedNote: Made an account before? It may have been cleared from this browser. Import your recovery phrase once — it'll remember you and only ask for your password next time.
onboarding.custodyNote: {{wallet}} keeps your key; create/import stores it encrypted in this browser.
onboarding.setPasswordBody: This encrypts your key on this device. We never see it, and it can't be reset — so remember it.
onboarding.savePhraseBody: These 24 words are the only way to recover your account on another device. Write them down and keep them offline. Anyone with them controls your account.
onboarding.savedConfirm: I've saved my recovery phrase somewhere safe.
onboarding.phrasePlaceholder: Enter your 12 or 24-word phrase, separated by spaces
